people.name: Great_Sea
people.line: The Mediterranean Sea, the western boundary of the Promised Land.

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

translations.web: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
translations.bsb: And on the west side, the Great Sea will be the boundary up to a point opposite Lebo-hamath. This will be the western boundary.
translations.kjv: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.
translations.asv: And the west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as over against the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
